g.text: Okafor has pinned a single word to the board above his desk: NORTHWIND. "I need ideas," he says. "Every
way a company with no ships could earn ninety thousand a month." Varma, from the doorway: "And I need
one plate number, read correctly, from a camera log. Not ideas. One answer." Same workstation, same
model. The difference is a dial.

Low T: the favourite takes almost everything. High T: the long tail gets a real chance.
. Top-k and top-p cut the tail before the draw
top_k is a fixed count. top_p adapts: few tokens when the model is sure, many when it is not.

The camera's partial plate KB 7?4 ?LR matches one registered vehicle in the Gate 2 car park: KB 714 FLR,
a grey saloon belonging to Raj Malhotra. It left at 23:47 and came back at 23:59.
Okafor reads the brainstormed leads, crosses out the ones that only rephrase "fraud", and circles one he
wrote himself: invoices timed to someone's travel. "Ideas are cheap," Varma says. "Readings are not.
Know which one you are asking for."
